title: MuxRay FLV media summary v3
description: Opt-in bounded whole-index sequential MP3 frame summary beside unchanged v2 first-header and FLV Tag timing facts. Frame bodies, CRC, reservoir and audio are not decoded.

complete.description: True only when existing media analysis and MP3 sequential framing coverage are complete. Retained-event truncation does not make coverage incomplete.

dtsTimeline.description: Raw uint32 FLV DTS observations in source order; timestamps are not unwrapped. Sample count measures media Tags, not decoded frames or audio samples.

ptsTimeline.description: Timeline of exact AVC PTS values: raw uint32 DTS plus signed 24-bit CompositionTime.

bitrate.description: Covered FLV media Tag DataSize bytes over forward-DTS intervals; final groups are excluded. V2 audio additionally breaks coverage on codec/unknown/unclassified barriers and MP3 parameter changes.

changedFromPrevious.description: Comparison with the preceding complete AAC configuration in the same codec epoch; absent when no comparison was made.

changeCount.description: Number of compared source events whose raw configuration fingerprint changed; independent of retained-event truncation.

changedFromPrevious.description: Comparison with the preceding complete AVC configuration in the same codec epoch; absent when no comparison was made.

changeCount.description: Number of compared source events whose raw configuration fingerprint changed; independent of retained-event truncation.

audioCodecs.description: Partitions all audio Tags by trusted SoundFormat. Switch count compares consecutive known identities, including unsupported formats; unknown Tags clear the baseline.

mp3.description: Subset of complete, unfiltered SoundFormat=2 Tags with a FLV audio-header byte. Malformed first MPEG headers remain in track/header counts but are not media observations.

mp3Headers.description: All counters continue beyond the retained source-order event prefix. Parameter and bitrate changes compare only complete headers within the same trusted MP3 epoch.

mp3Frames.description: Counts complete declared MPEG Layer III boundaries only within complete unfiltered SoundFormat=2 Tags. An invalid/free-format/truncated boundary stops that Tag, with no sync scan. The attempted-header budget is global; retained events are independent. SoundData bytes partition into frameBytes + unresolvedBytes. HeaderBytesRead counts four bytes for each inspected complete fixed header, reusing v2 first-header reads; it excludes independent v2 reads after the frame budget. No decoded-duration or CRC validity claim.

mp3Duration.description: Reduced exact seconds from complete observed frames: sum(samplesPerFrame / samplingFrequencyHz). 0/1 when none. Not FLV DTS range, decoder output, or file playback duration.

mp3FrameEvent.description: Source-order retained observation. frameIndex is zero-based in the containing Tag. DTS is the Tag timestamp. Complete events span the frame; stop events span the unresolved suffix. Changes compare complete frames only, broken by unknown/non-MP3 audio, unresolved tails and backward DTS; video interleaving does not break comparisons.
